record.clinical_notes: 3-month h/o recurrent colicky RUQ pain, fatty food intolerance. USG abdomen: multiple gallstones, GB wall thickened - chronic calculous cholecystitis. LFTs WNL. Elective lap cholecystectomy under GA. Intra-op: chronically inflamed GB, Calot's triangle well delineated, CBD not injured, specimen retrieved intact. Smooth post-op course, oral fluids started 6h post-op, ambulated same evening. Discharged POD1, low-fat diet and wound care advice given.
